name: Background Studio
pitch: Cut the backgrounds out of hundreds of pictures, sort them and merge duplicates, all offline on your Mac.
problem: Background removers want your pictures uploaded, a few at a time.

stats.label: open-source AI models to choose from

features.title: Cut-outs in bulk
features.text: Drop in whole folders and get transparent PNGs, with your originals untouched.
details: Cancel, resume and retry across hundreds of pictures
Re-running a batch skips what's already done
Also saves copies on white, black or any colour

features.title: Fine-tune any cut-out
features.text: A before and after slider, with the controls to fix what the model missed.
details: Keep and erase brushes, zoom and edge sliders
Crop and straighten without redoing the batch

screen.alt: The before and after editor over a sample picture

features.title: Sort & tag
features.text: File pictures into your own categories with single key presses.
details: Up to three rounds, such as place, content and stars
Copy into folders, add Finder tags or export a spreadsheet

screen.alt: Sorting a sample ticket into categories, with a key for each

features.title: Compare & merge
features.text: See what's the same and what's different across folders, then combine them.
details: A Venn diagram of which folders hold each file
Spots exact copies, re-saved files and edited versions

screen.alt: A Venn diagram comparing two folders of sample pictures

screens.alt: Background Studio's three tools above a batch of sample cut-outs

facts.worksOn: A Mac, or a browser demo
